description.value: You delve into other magical traditions. Add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Grisly Growths] spell to your dirge. Add the following spells to your dirge as soon as you gain the ability to cast necromancer spells of that rank: 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Execute], 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Desiccate], 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Massacre]. You can prepare and cast these spells as occult spells.
